name: legacy
description: The untagged node layout written before this table: bare rkyv bytes with an inline 28-byte manifest. Never written as a tag; reserved so no tagged layout reuses its number.

name: tagged
description: Tagged node: version; kind; header length; manifest fields; zero padding to 16 bytes; rkyv body for the kind.

name: segment
description: Leaf node: sorted entries; the body is an archived Segment.

name: index
description: Interior node: child links with separators and per-link buffered ops; the body is an archived Index.

name: inline_n
description: Values whose encoded form is longer than this spill to their own block; a spilled value's key carries a prefix and the whole-value hash. Critical: it decides how values are laid out in keys.

name: spill_prefix
description: How many leading raw value bytes a spilled value's key carries as its order-preserving prefix. Critical: it decides how values are laid out in keys.

name: max_separator
description: Keys longer than this never become boundaries; bounds every separator.

name: max_segment
description: Node weight target in weighted bytes between coin-decided cuts; 0 turns byte pacing off.

name: frame_ceiling_factor
description: A frame over this multiple of max_segment is force-split at accepted seams; 0 turns the ceiling off.

name: anchor_selector
description: Which candidate seam a forced cut anchors at: 0 rendezvous (hash-minimal); 1 hybrid (shortest separator; then hash-minimal).

name: entry_overhead
description: Weight charged per leaf entry beyond its key bytes and value payload weight; also meters buffered ops.

name: key_overhead
description: Weight the per-key cut floor charges beyond a key's bytes where the value is not in hand.

name: link_overhead
description: Weight charged per index link beyond its separator bytes and the 32-byte child hash.
